rationales.F01: Complex congenital heart disease is a known risk factor for various arrhythmias.
rationales.F08: Irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating is characteristic of atrial fibrillation or atrial flutter, but the presence of intermittently visible P waves suggests another type of supraventricular tachycardia.
